concepts.def: Jobs: médecin (doctor), professeur, ingénieur, avocat (lawyer), infirmier/infirmière (nurse). No article: 'Je suis professeur.'
Simple future for plans: 'Je travaillerai...' (I will work). Stem + endings: -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont.
'J'aimerais être...' (I would like to be...), 'Je voudrais devenir...' (I would like to become...).
Une année sabbatique (gap year), à l'université, faire des études (to study), un diplôme (degree).
Le travail, le salaire (wage), le patron (boss), un entretien (interview), un stage (internship).
Justifying a career: 'parce que je suis créatif/patient/organisé'. Useful adjectives for personal statements.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Area D: The World of Work — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area D: The World of Work brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area D: The World of Work.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence means 'I would like to be a doctor'?
options: J'aimerais être médecin.
J'aime être un médecin.
J'aimerais être un médecin.
Je serai médecin hier.
an internship
a salary
an interview
a degree

mcqs.q: Which verbs take 'être' as their auxiliary in the passé composé?
options: J'étudie des maths.
All verbs take avoir.
Just movement verbs - never reflexives.
Movement/state-change verbs (DR & MRS VAN DER TRAMP) and all reflexive verbs.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I study maths' in French?
options: J'étudie maths.
J'étudie les maths.
Present - 'Il fait beau'.
J'étudie des maths.

mcqs.q: How do you describe weather in the past, e.g. 'it was sunny'?
options: Passé composé - 'Il a fait beau' (which suggests a completed event).
All verbs take avoir.
Present - 'Il fait beau'.
Imperfect - 'Il faisait beau' (descriptive past state).
